claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Yohimbine is a weak, non-cytotoxic adrenergic/aminergic receptor antagonist that is unlikely to kill cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and mediated by cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress or nonspecific receptor antagonism rather than a potent cytotoxic mechanism.
